# mcdoc / mxdoc

Generates browsable documentation for installed and local instrument/component files, under `tools/Python/mcdoc`.

*(This page is auto-generated by `generate_tool_docs.py` from `mcdoc.py` - do not hand-edit the table below.)*

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `searchterm` | search filter or .instr/.comp file |
| `--install`, `-i` | generate installation master doc page |
| `--dir DIR`, `-d DIR` | add search results from this directory |
| `--manual`, `-m` | open the system manual |
| `--comps`, `-c` | open the component manual |
| `--web`, `-w` | open the mcstas website |
| `--verbose`, `-v` | prints a parsing log during execution |
| `--md`, `-M` | also emit Markdown (.md) doc files |
| `--tex`, `-T` | also emit LaTeX (.tex) doc files |
| `--all-formats`, `-A` | emit HTML, Markdown and LaTeX doc files |
| `--in-repo` | Place generated output(s) next to comp files (no master doc page) |
| `--outdir OUTDIR`, `-o OUTDIR` | write generated results to this directory (in-repo use only) |

*(No `searchterm`/`--install`/`--manual`/`--comps`/`--web` at all &rarr; browse the existing installed docs directly.)*
